text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P1 required integration. Current source has profile/BlockExecutor for the condition path but no ProfileHrfPlan or adaptive conditional-readout implementation in model/fit/mvpa-fit. TrialReadout explicitly promises a response-independent linear map; extending it to shape estimates learned from the same response would violate that contract. The existing sibling-plan proposal is therefore justified, not a redundant fixed-plan facade. Reuse the bounded executor/sink budgets and exact data/model identities, and prove cancellation/chunk/output invariance after trial-backend integration. Keep conditional transpose separate from the derivative of the complete adaptive estimator, with explicit mvpa-fit admission; no fixed design may be fabricated for a shape-varying trial operator. Preserve PHRF-07 and PHRF-28 dependencies and P1 priority. Source inspection only; no new plan/API implementation.
